items.text: Pocket Bog · The Rainbarrel Pet Club
Last Tuesday, a beetle checked itself into our lost-and-found. By Friday it had signed the lease. Welcome to our very damp pet club.
A lantern-lit marsh with a tiny clubhouse beneath the reeds
A tapping sound behind the jam jars means Tangletoot wants his boots back.
The Rainbarrel Pet Club  •  Leave the lid ajar on your way out.
Pocket Bog · The Rainbarrel Pet Club
Pick a resident, forage for its supper and earn keeper stamps. Write down the keeper code to bring your pet back on another visit.

items.text: Pocket Bog · The Rainbarrel Pet Club
Three illustrated specimens. Zero certified house-trained pets.
Feeds on dew and unattended picnic menus. Mistakes a thimble for a swimming pool.
A moth with its own lantern. Will read your field notes over your shoulder after sunset.
A boot-wearing newt. Counts puddles for a living but keeps forgetting number eight.

scenes.title: The night census
scenes.body: Rainfall: four thimbles. Beetles counted: twelve. Beetles counted twice after presenting fake moustaches: eleven.

scenes.title: Report from the lamp
scenes.body: Bramblewick has been promoted to deputy lighthouse. Her first order was to replace the bell with a biscuit tin.

scenes.title: Missing property
scenes.body: One left boot, size acorn. Last seen rowing across the saucer with a teaspoon. Please return before morning roll call.
